hook.en: Two shirts and three trousers give six different outfits. Pairing every element of one set with every element of another is the *Cartesian product*.

title.en: Form A × B and count its elements

say.en: Two shirts and three trousers give six different outfits. Pairing every element of one set with every element of another is the Cartesian product. In this lesson: Use ordered pairs.
Form A times B and count its elements.

body.en: An *ordered* pair $(a, b)$ has a first and a second entry; $(a, b) = (c, d)$ only when $a = c$ and $b = d$. The Cartesian product $A \times B = \{(a, b) : a \in A, b \in B\}$. If $A$ or $B$ is empty, $A \times B = \phi$. In general $A \times B \ne B \times A$.
body.kn: ಕ್ರಮಯುತ ಜೋಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕ್ರಮ ಮುಖ್ಯ. A × B ಎಂದರೆ ಮೊದಲ ಅಂಶ A ಯಿಂದ, ಎರಡನೆಯದು B ಯಿಂದ ಬರುವ ಎಲ್ಲ ಕ್ರಮಯುತ ಜೋಡಿಗಳ ಗಣ.

narration.en: In an ordered pair the order matters. A cross B is the set of all ordered pairs whose first entry is from A and second entry from B.

say.en: In an ordered pair the order matters. A cross B is the set of all ordered pairs whose first entry is from A and second entry from B. (a, b) is not equal to (b, a) unless a equals b.

Order matters: (1, a) is not (a, 1), so A × B is not B × A.

problem.en: A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {x, y}. Write A × B and find n(A × B).

steps.en: Pair each element of A with each element of B.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {x, y}. Write A × B and find n(A × B).

say.en: Let us solve this together. A = {1, 2, 3} and B = {x, y}. Write A times B and find nA times B.
Pair each element of A with each element of B.
nA times B equals 3 times 2 equals 6.
So the answer is 6 ordered pairs.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. If (x/3 + 1, y − 2/3) = (5/3, 1/3), find x and y.

say.en: Let us solve this together. If (x over 3 plus 1, y minus 2 over 3) equals (5 over 3, 1 over 3), find x and y.
x over 3 plus 1 equals 5 over 3 so x over 3 equals 2 over 3 so x equals 2.
y minus 2 over 3 equals 1 over 3 so y equals 1.
So the answer is x equals 2, y equals 1.
